"''He didn't say.|Lampay Fay and Tion Medon|}} '''Lampay Fay''' was a [[Pau'an]] [[Gender|Male]] who served as [[aide]]-de-camp to [[Port Administrator]] [[Tion Medon]] of [[Pau City]] on the [[planet]] [[Utapau]]. After the planet was occupied by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY]], Fay accompanied Medon to meet with the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when Kenobi arrived on Utapau in search of Separatist [[General]] [[Grievous]]. Medon covertly informed the [[Jedi]] of Grievous's presence, and after the Jedi told the administrator to prepare their [[warrior]]s, Fay asked if Kenobi had mentioned bringing additional forces. [[212th Attack Battalion|Republic clone forces]] then arrived and [[Battle of Utapau|fought]] alongside the [[Pau'an Warrior|Pau'ans]] to defeat the Separatists. ==Biography== Lampay Fay was a [[Pau'an]] [[Gender|male]] who hailed from an eminent lineage on the [[planet]] [[Utapau]], the [[Unidentified patriach|patriach]] of which was among the first to encourage trade between the world's natives and other planets. During the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Fay served as the [[aide]]-de-camp to [[Tion Medon]], [[Port Administrator]]''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' and [[Prime Minister]] of [[Pau City]] on Utapau. Although Utapau remained neutral during the war, it was occupied by the Separatists in the final [[Standard day|days]] of the conflict when [[General]] [[Grievous]] selected it as a hiding place for the [[Executive Separatist Council]].[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] Pau City's occupants were then held hostage by the occupiers. When the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived in Pau City in [[19 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]]. while searching the [[Outer Rim Territories]] for Grievous, the Separatists remained out of view while Medon, Fay, and a number of other Pau'ans approached Kenobi's [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor|ship]] on a landing pad. Fay hung back while Medon spoke with Kenobi, with the Prime Minister initially claiming the war had not reached Utapau when Kenobi asked for [[fuel]] and to use the planet as a base during his search; however, once a group of [[Utai]] began the refueling process, Medon stepped closer to Kenobi and revealed the presence of Grievous and the size of his [[Separatist Droid Army|forces]] to the [[Jedi]] in hushed tones. Kenobi warned Medon to have his people take shelter and prepare any [[warrior]]s they had then returned to his [[starfighter]]. Medon returned to Fay and the other Pau'ans and as they left the landing pad, Fay asked Medon whether Kenobi had said he would bring additional warriors. Medon informed the aide-de-camp that the Jedi had not clarified, although Kenobi had in fact already contacted his [[Clone trooper|clone]] [[212th Attack Battalion|forces]] to inform them about Grievous. Kenobi then sought out Grievous and confronted him, with the [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone forces]] arriving as the two fought. [[Pau'an Warrior]]s then [[Battle of Utapau|fought]] alongside the [[Cloning|clones]] against the Separatists, succeeding in defeating the occupiers, [[Death|killing]] the general, and reclaiming the world. ==Personality and traits== Lampay Fay had [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s and gray, [[blood]]less skin with scarlet offsets. The skin's color was the result of underground living and a raw [[Foodstuff|meat]] [[diet]]. ==Equipment== Fay wore a dark red [[Clothing|robe]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|I turned up and sat around with six other tall people. Waiting our turn to be escorted to the creature shop. As we left another six tall men arrived and as we entered the creature shop another six tall men exited. The aim was to find people who resembled Bruce Spence's physique. I was one of the lucky two.|Goran Kleut|{{WebCite|url=https://starwarsinterviews.com/prequel-trilogy/episode-iii-revenge-of-the-sith/goran-kleut-lampay-fay|text=Goran Kleut (Lampa Fay)|author=[[Dennis Pellegrom]]|date=2010-09|work=[[Star Wars Interviews]]|archivedate=20220930161253|nolive=1}}}} Lampay Fay was portrayed by [[Goran Kleut]] in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' Kleut was one of many tall actors who auditioned for the roles of the two Pau'ans that accompany Medon in the film, as [[Lucasfilm]] wanted people who matched the physique of Medon's actor, [[Bruce Spence]]. After Kleut was chosen, he had to regularly visit the film's creature shop in order to test parts of the costume or the mask. Kleut's platform scene was then filmed on Wednesday, [[August 20]], [[2003]] on Stage 1 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]].''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]'' Kleut also filmed an additional scene as Fay during pick-ups that would have acted as an alternative to the platform scene, but was not ultimately used. Involving a close-up of Fay that required the character to have a detailed mask, the scene was set in a golden room and was filmed against green screen on a sound stage. It took several takes before director [[George Lucas]] was satisfied, with Lucas asking that the scene be faster. Fay's dialogue in the final release of the film was actually recorded for the cut scene and later dubbed over the platform version. In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Lampay Fay's name was first used in the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'', which initially launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}} the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}} [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivedate=20210505080831}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Lampay Fay/Legends|Lampay Fay]] was mentioned prior to the release of the film in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[James Luceno]]''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'' and released on [[April 2]], 2005.{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|nolive=1}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} *''[[Force Collector]]'' {{Ab|Force Collector (audiobook)}} {{Voice}} {{Vision|Karr Nuq Sin}} ==Sources== {{SourceContents|issue={{HelmetCollectionCite|25|parent=1}}|contents= *{{HelmetCollectionCite|25|Highlights of the Saga}} {{Po}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|25|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{Po}} }} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *{{ForceCollection|Lampay Fay|star=1}} {{1stID|Lampay Fay}} *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *[[Star Wars Day-at-a-Time Calendar 2021|''Star Wars'' Day-at-a-Time Calendar 2021]] {{Po}} *{{BustCollectionCite|68|Behind the Cameras}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The End of the Clone Wars}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Lampay Fay |uk=Лампей Фей }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Fay, Lampay}} [[Category:Clerical workers and assistants]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Pau'ans]]
